_comment: One entry per image file in this folder. Every field is optional and an image with no entry still renders. alt = what a screen reader says. who = the name shown under it, and initials are fine. note = one line on what it shows. wide = true for a photograph of a room, which gets the site's grayscale; leave it off for screenshots, which should stay in colour.

_example.png.note: Signed three weeks after the session
